name: Smashed Cheesy Potatoes with Yogurt Sauce
desc: Boiled potatoes smashed onto a bed of grated cheese and baked until the cheese fries into a crisp base, served with a garlicky mint yogurt sauce.

source.title: Smashed Cheesy Potatoes with Yogurt Sauce
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 cup grated kaşar or Parmesan cheese, divided
1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more for the cooking water
ingredients.prep: plus more for the cooking water

steps: Put the potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water by an inch and salt the water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and cook until a knife slides in easily, 15 to 20 min. Drain and let cool for 10 min, then cut each potato in half.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.

Drizzle 1 1/2 tbsp of the oil over the parchment and sprinkle half the cheese in 8 small mounds. Set a potato half cut side down on each mound and smash it flat, about 1/2 inch thick, with the bottom of a glass.
Sprinkle the potatoes with the thyme, chili flakes, pepper and 1/2 tsp salt, then drizzle with the remaining 1 1/2 tbsp oil and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until the tops are well browned and the cheese underneath is crisp and golden, about 20 min.
While they bake, stir together the yogurt, mayonnaise, garlic, dried mint and 1/4 tsp salt. Serve the potatoes hot with the sauce.
tips: Translated from Turkish. The cheese goes under the potato so it fries into a crisp base.
Most Parmesan smashed potato recipes bake at 450°F; this one runs at 400°F, so give it the full 20 min or a few more for deep color.
